ModMetaData.name: Genesis: Configs
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Cruesoe's mod settings preset for the Genesis suite. Applies preferred settings to third-party mods installed alongside Genesis, the same way ferny's Mod Configs does for the original Progression modpack.
Includes the ferny's Mod Configs settings that apply to the Genesis Mod Pack, so ferny's Mod Configs is no longer needed alongside it.
